# langfuse_annotation_queue (Resource)

Manage an annotation queue in a project using project-scoped credentials. Import format: project_public_key:project_secret_key:annotation_queue_id.

~> **Note:** Annotation queues can only be created and read through the Langfuse public API; they cannot be updated or deleted. Every change therefore forces a new queue, and because queue names are unique and the previous queue cannot be deleted, a change must also rename the queue (the plan fails otherwise). Destroying this resource removes it from the Terraform state with a warning and leaves the queue and its items in Langfuse; delete it in the Langfuse UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "project_public_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "project_secret_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "langfuse_score_config" "accuracy" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "accuracy"
  data_type          = "NUMERIC"
  min_value          = 0
  max_value          = 1
}

# Annotation queues cannot be updated or deleted through the API: any change
# needs a new name, and the previous queue stays in Langfuse.
resource "langfuse_annotation_queue" "review" {
  project_public_key = var.project_public_key
  project_secret_key = var.project_secret_key
  name               = "expert-review"
  description        = "Traces flagged for review by a domain expert."
  score_config_ids   = [langfuse_score_config.accuracy.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the annotation queue, unique within the project. Changing it forces a new queue; the previous one is left in Langfuse.
- `project_public_key` (String, Sensitive) The project public key used to authenticate API calls.
- `project_secret_key` (String, Sensitive) The project secret key used to authenticate API calls.
- `score_config_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the score configs annotators fill in for each item. At least one is required. Changing them forces a new queue and requires a new name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the annotation queue. Changing it forces a new queue and requires a new name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the annotation queue.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import langfuse_annotation_queue.example "${PROJECT_PUBLIC_KEY}:${PROJECT_SECRET_KEY}:${ANNOTATION_QUEUE_ID}"
```
